#include "kernel.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <math.h>

#define WH 4
#define WW 4
#define N 16
#define C_DIM 32
#define HIDDEN 128

__global__ __launch_bounds__(32, 8) void swin_block_kernel(
    const __half* __restrict__ x_in,
    __half* __restrict__ x_out,
    const __half* __restrict__ ln1_w, const __half* __restrict__ ln1_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ qkv_w, const __half* __restrict__ qkv_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ proj_w, const __half* __restrict__ proj_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ ln2_w, const __half* __restrict__ ln2_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ fc1_w, const __half* __restrict__ fc1_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ fc2_w, const __half* __restrict__ fc2_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ rpe_bias,
    int H, int W)
{
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int nW = W / WW;
    const int win_id = blockIdx.x;
    const int b = blockIdx.y;
    const int nh = win_id / nW;
    const int nw = win_id % nW;

    __shared__ float x_tok[N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float resid[N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float q_s[N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float k_s[N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float v_s[N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float attn[N][N];
    __shared__ float attn_out[N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float mlp_h[N][HIDDEN];
    __shared__ float rpe_s[N][N];

    int hh_base = nh * WH;
    int ww_base = nw * WW;

    // Vectorized load
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < WH; i++) {
        int hh = hh_base + i;
        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(
            x_in + ((b * H + hh) * W + ww_base) * C_DIM);
        int idx0 = tid;
        int idx1 = tid + 32;
        __half2 v0 = src[idx0];
        __half2 v1 = src[idx1];
        int t0 = idx0 / 16;
        int c0 = (idx0 % 16) * 2;
        int t1 = idx1 / 16;
        int c1 = (idx1 % 16) * 2;
        int n0 = i * WW + t0;
        int n1 = i * WW + t1;
        float2 f0 = __half22float2(v0);
        float2 f1 = __half22float2(v1);
        resid[n0][c0] = f0.x; resid[n0][c0+1] = f0.y;
        x_tok[n0][c0] = f0.x; x_tok[n0][c0+1] = f0.y;
        resid[n1][c1] = f1.x; resid[n1][c1+1] = f1.y;
        x_tok[n1][c1] = f1.x; x_tok[n1][c1+1] = f1.y;
    }

    // Preload rpe_bias to shared
    #pragma unroll
    for (int idx = tid; idx < N * N; idx += 32) {
        rpe_s[idx / N][idx % N] = __half2float(rpe_bias[idx]);
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // LN1
    float ln1_w_v = __half2float(ln1_w[tid]);
    float ln1_b_v = __half2float(ln1_b[tid]);
    #pragma unroll
    for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
        float v = x_tok[n][tid];
        float s = v;
        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, s, off);
        float mean = s * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
        float d = v - mean;
        float sq = d * d;
        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sq += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, sq, off);
        float var = sq * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
        float inv = rsqrtf(var + 1e-5f);
        x_tok[n][tid] = d * inv * ln1_w_v + ln1_b_v;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // QKV
    {
        float wq[C_DIM], wk[C_DIM], wv[C_DIM];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < C_DIM; c++) {
            wq[c] = __half2float(qkv_w[(0 * C_DIM + tid) * C_DIM + c]);
            wk[c] = __half2float(qkv_w[(1 * C_DIM + tid) * C_DIM + c]);
            wv[c] = __half2float(qkv_w[(2 * C_DIM + tid) * C_DIM + c]);
        }
        float bq = __half2float(qkv_b[0 * C_DIM + tid]);
        float bk = __half2float(qkv_b[1 * C_DIM + tid]);
        float bv = __half2float(qkv_b[2 * C_DIM + tid]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float aq = bq, ak = bk, av = bv;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int c = 0; c < C_DIM; c++) {
                float xv = x_tok[n][c];
                aq += xv * wq[c];
                ak += xv * wk[c];
                av += xv * wv[c];
            }
            q_s[n][tid] = aq;
            k_s[n][tid] = ak;
            v_s[n][tid] = av;
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // Attention scores
    const float scale = 1.0f / sqrtf((float)C_DIM);
    #pragma unroll
    for (int idx = tid; idx < N * N; idx += 32) {
        int i = idx / N;
        int j = idx % N;
        float acc = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < C_DIM; c++) {
            acc += q_s[i][c] * k_s[j][c];
        }
        acc = acc * scale + rpe_s[i][j];
        attn[i][j] = acc;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // Softmax - parallelize across 16 rows using 16 threads
    if (tid < N) {
        int i = tid;
        float mx = attn[i][0];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 1; j < N; j++) mx = fmaxf(mx, attn[i][j]);
        float sum = 0.f;
        float vals[N];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            float e = __expf(attn[i][j] - mx);
            vals[j] = e;
            sum += e;
        }
        float inv = 1.0f / sum;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) attn[i][j] = vals[j] * inv;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // attn @ v
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        float acc = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            acc += attn[i][j] * v_s[j][tid];
        }
        attn_out[i][tid] = acc;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // Proj + residual + LN2 fused
    float ln2_w_v = __half2float(ln2_w[tid]);
    float ln2_b_v = __half2float(ln2_b[tid]);
    {
        float bias = __half2float(proj_b[tid]);
        float wrow[C_DIM];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < C_DIM; c++) {
            wrow[c] = __half2float(proj_w[tid * C_DIM + c]);
        }
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float acc = bias;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int c = 0; c < C_DIM; c++) {
                acc += attn_out[n][c] * wrow[c];
            }
            float y = resid[n][tid] + acc;
            resid[n][tid] = y;
            x_tok[n][tid] = y;
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // LN2
    #pragma unroll
    for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
        float v = x_tok[n][tid];
        float s = v;
        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, s, off);
        float mean = s * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
        float d = v - mean;
        float sq = d * d;
        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sq += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, sq, off);
        float var = sq * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
        float inv = rsqrtf(var + 1e-5f);
        x_tok[n][tid] = d * inv * ln2_w_v + ln2_b_v;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // FC1
    {
        float w0[C_DIM], w1[C_DIM], w2[C_DIM], w3[C_DIM];
        int h0 = 0 * 32 + tid;
        int h1 = 1 * 32 + tid;
        int h2 = 2 * 32 + tid;
        int h3 = 3 * 32 + tid;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < C_DIM; c++) {
            w0[c] = __half2float(fc1_w[h0 * C_DIM + c]);
            w1[c] = __half2float(fc1_w[h1 * C_DIM + c]);
            w2[c] = __half2float(fc1_w[h2 * C_DIM + c]);
            w3[c] = __half2float(fc1_w[h3 * C_DIM + c]);
        }
        float b0 = __half2float(fc1_b[h0]);
        float b1 = __half2float(fc1_b[h1]);
        float b2 = __half2float(fc1_b[h2]);
        float b3 = __half2float(fc1_b[h3]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float a0 = b0, a1 = b1, a2 = b2, a3 = b3;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int c = 0; c < C_DIM; c++) {
                float xv = x_tok[n][c];
                a0 += xv * w0[c];
                a1 += xv * w1[c];
                a2 += xv * w2[c];
                a3 += xv * w3[c];
            }
            const float k0 = 0.7978845608f;
            const float k1 = 0.044715f;
            float t0 = k0 * (a0 + k1 * a0 * a0 * a0);
            float t1 = k0 * (a1 + k1 * a1 * a1 * a1);
            float t2 = k0 * (a2 + k1 * a2 * a2 * a2);
            float t3 = k0 * (a3 + k1 * a3 * a3 * a3);
            mlp_h[n][h0] = 0.5f * a0 * (1.0f + tanhf(t0));
            mlp_h[n][h1] = 0.5f * a1 * (1.0f + tanhf(t1));
            mlp_h[n][h2] = 0.5f * a2 * (1.0f + tanhf(t2));
            mlp_h[n][h3] = 0.5f * a3 * (1.0f + tanhf(t3));
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // FC2 + residual + vectorized store
    {
        float bias = __half2float(fc2_b[tid]);
        float wrow[HIDDEN];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int h = 0; h < HIDDEN; h++) {
            wrow[h] = __half2float(fc2_w[tid * HIDDEN + h]);
        }
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float acc = bias;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int h = 0; h < HIDDEN; h++) {
                acc += mlp_h[n][h] * wrow[h];
            }
            attn_out[n][tid] = resid[n][tid] + acc;
        }
        __syncthreads();

        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < WH; i++) {
            int hh = hh_base + i;
            __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(
                x_out + ((b * H + hh) * W + ww_base) * C_DIM);
            int idx0 = tid;
            int idx1 = tid + 32;
            int t0 = idx0 / 16;
            int c0 = (idx0 % 16) * 2;
            int t1 = idx1 / 16;
            int c1 = (idx1 % 16) * 2;
            int n0 = i * WW + t0;
            int n1 = i * WW + t1;
            __half2 h0 = __floats2half2_rn(attn_out[n0][c0], attn_out[n0][c0+1]);
            __half2 h1 = __floats2half2_rn(attn_out[n1][c1], attn_out[n1][c1+1]);
            dst[idx0] = h0;
            dst[idx1] = h1;
        }
    }
}

void launch_swin_block(
    const __half* x,
    __half* out,
    const __half* ln1_w, const __half* ln1_b,
    const __half* qkv_w, const __half* qkv_b,
    const __half* proj_w, const __half* proj_b,
    const __half* ln2_w, const __half* ln2_b,
    const __half* fc1_w, const __half* fc1_b,
    const __half* fc2_w, const __half* fc2_b,
    const __half* rpe_bias,
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    cudaStream_t stream)
{
    int nH = H / WH;
    int nW = W / WW;
    int num_windows = nH * nW;
    dim3 grid(num_windows, B);
    dim3 block(32);
    swin_block_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
        x, out,
        ln1_w, ln1_b, qkv_w, qkv_b, proj_w, proj_b,
        ln2_w, ln2_b, fc1_w, fc1_b, fc2_w, fc2_b,
        rpe_bias, H, W);
}

#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <c10/cuda/CUDAStream.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <vector>
#include "kernel.h"

static torch::Tensor g_rpe_bias;
static torch::Tensor g_norm1_w, g_norm1_b;
static torch::Tensor g_qkv_w, g_qkv_b;
static torch::Tensor g_proj_w, g_proj_b;
static torch::Tensor g_norm2_w, g_norm2_b;
static torch::Tensor g_fc1_w, g_fc1_b;
static torch::Tensor g_fc2_w, g_fc2_b;

void set_params(
    torch::Tensor rpe_bias,
    torch::Tensor norm1_w, torch::Tensor norm1_b,
    torch::Tensor qkv_w, torch::Tensor qkv_b,
    torch::Tensor proj_w, torch::Tensor proj_b,
    torch::Tensor norm2_w, torch::Tensor norm2_b,
    torch::Tensor fc1_w, torch::Tensor fc1_b,
    torch::Tensor fc2_w, torch::Tensor fc2_b)
{
    g_rpe_bias = rpe_bias.contiguous();
    g_norm1_w = norm1_w.contiguous();
    g_norm1_b = norm1_b.contiguous();
    g_qkv_w = qkv_w.contiguous();
    g_qkv_b = qkv_b.contiguous();
    g_proj_w = proj_w.contiguous();
    g_proj_b = proj_b.contiguous();
    g_norm2_w = norm2_w.contiguous();
    g_norm2_b = norm2_b.contiguous();
    g_fc1_w = fc1_w.contiguous();
    g_fc1_b = fc1_b.contiguous();
    g_fc2_w = fc2_w.contiguous();
    g_fc2_b = fc2_b.contiguous();
}

torch::Tensor run(torch::Tensor x) {
    TORCH_CHECK(x.is_cuda(), "x must be CUDA");
    TORCH_CHECK(x.scalar_type() == torch::kFloat16, "x must be fp16");
    auto xc = x.contiguous();
    int B = xc.size(0);
    int H = xc.size(1);
    int W = xc.size(2);
    int C = xc.size(3);
    auto out = torch::empty_like(xc);

    launch_swin_block(
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(xc.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<__half*>(out.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_norm1_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_norm1_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_qkv_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_qkv_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_proj_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_proj_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_norm2_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_norm2_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_fc1_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_fc1_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_fc2_w.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_fc2_b.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        reinterpret_cast<const __half*>(g_rpe_bias.data_ptr<at::Half>()),
        B, H, W, C,
        c10::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream());

    return out;
}

PYBIND11_MODULE(TORCH_EXTENSION_NAME, m) {
    m.def("set_params", &set_params, "Set model parameters");
    m.def("run", &run, "Run swin block");
}

        int i = tid;
        float mx = attn[i][0];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 1; j < N; j++) mx = fmaxf(mx, attn[i][j]);
        float sum = 0.f;
        float vals[N];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            float e = __expf(attn[i][j] - mx);
            vals[j] = e;
            sum += e;
        }
        float inv = 1.0f / sum;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) attn[i][j] = vals[j] * inv;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // attn @ v
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        float acc = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            acc += attn[i][j] * v_s[j][tid];
        }
        attn_out[i][tid] = acc;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // Proj + residual + LN2 fused
    float ln2_w_v = __half2float(ln2_w[tid]);
    float ln2_b_v = __half2float(ln2_b[tid]);
    {
        float bias = __half2float(proj_b[tid]);
        float wrow[C_DIM];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < C_DIM; c++) {
            wrow[c] = __half2float(proj_w[tid * C_DIM + c]);
        }
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float acc = bias;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int c = 0; c < C_DIM; c++) {
                acc += attn_out[n][c] * wrow[c];
            }
            float y = resid[n][tid] + acc;
            resid[n][tid] = y;
            x_tok[n][tid] = y;
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // LN2
    #pragma unroll
    for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
        float v = x_tok[n][tid];
        float s = v;
        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, s, off);
        float mean = s * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
        float d = v - mean;
        float sq = d * d;
        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sq += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, sq, off);
        float var = sq * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
        float inv = rsqrtf(var + 1e-5f);
        x_tok[n][tid] = d * inv * ln2_w_v + ln2_b_v;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // FC1
    {
        float w0[C_DIM], w1[C_DIM], w2[C_DIM], w3[C_DIM];
        int h0 = 0 * 32 + tid;
        int h1 = 1 * 32 + tid;
        int h2 = 2 * 32 + tid;
        int h3 = 3 * 32 + tid;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int c = 0; c < C_DIM; c++) {
            w0[c] = __half2float(fc1_w[h0 * C_DIM + c]);
            w1[c] = __half2float(fc1_w[h1 * C_DIM + c]);
            w2[c] = __half2float(fc1_w[h2 * C_DIM + c]);
            w3[c] = __half2float(fc1_w[h3 * C_DIM + c]);
        }
        float b0 = __half2float(fc1_b[h0]);
        float b1 = __half2float(fc1_b[h1]);
        float b2 = __half2float(fc1_b[h2]);
        float b3 = __half2float(fc1_b[h3]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float a0 = b0, a1 = b1, a2 = b2, a3 = b3;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int c = 0; c < C_DIM; c++) {
                float xv = x_tok[n][c];
                a0 += xv * w0[c];
                a1 += xv * w1[c];
                a2 += xv * w2[c];
                a3 += xv * w3[c];
            }
            const float k0 = 0.7978845608f;
            const float k1 = 0.044715f;
            float t0 = k0 * (a0 + k1 * a0 * a0 * a0);
            float t1 = k0 * (a1 + k1 * a1 * a1 * a1);
            float t2 = k0 * (a2 + k1 * a2 * a2 * a2);
            float t3 = k0 * (a3 + k1 * a3 * a3 * a3);
            mlp_h[n][h0] = 0.5f * a0 * (1.0f + tanhf(t0));
            mlp_h[n][h1] = 0.5f * a1 * (1.0f + tanhf(t1));
            mlp_h[n][h2] = 0.5f * a2 * (1.0f + tanhf(t2));
            mlp_h[n][h3] = 0.5f * a3 * (1.0f + tanhf(t3));
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // FC2 + residual + vectorized store
    {
        float bias = __half2float(fc2_b[tid]);
        float wrow[HIDDEN];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int h = 0; h < HIDDEN; h++) {
            wrow[h] = __half2float(fc2_w[tid * HIDDEN + h]);
        }
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float acc = bias;
            #pragma unroll
            for (int h = 0; h < HIDDEN; h++) {
                acc += mlp_h[n][h] * wrow[h];
            }
            attn_out[n][tid] = resid[n][tid] + acc;
        }
        __syncthreads();

        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = 0; i < WH; i++) {
            int hh = hh_base + i;
            __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(
                x_out + ((b * H + hh) * W + ww_base) * C_DIM);
            int idx0 = tid;
            int idx1 = tid + 32;
            int t0 = idx0 / 16;
            int c0 = (idx0 % 16) * 2;
            int t1 = idx1 / 16;
            int c1 = (idx1 % 16) * 2;
            int n0 = i * WW + t0;
            int n1 = i * WW + t1;
            __half2 h0 = __floats2half2_rn(attn_out[n0][c0], attn_out[n0][c0+1]);
            __half2 h1 = __floats2half2_rn(attn_out[n1][c1], attn_out[n1][c1+1]);
            dst[idx0] = h0;
            dst[idx1] = h1;
        }
    }
}

void launch_swin_block(
    const __half* x,
    __half* out,
    const __half* ln1_w, const __half* ln1_b,
    const __half* qkv_w, const __half* qkv_b,
    const __half* proj_w, const __half* proj_b,
    const __half* ln2_w, const __half* ln2_b,
    const __half* fc1_w, const __half* fc1_b,
    const __half* fc2_w, const __half* fc2_b,
    const __half* rpe_bias,
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    cudaStream_t stream)
{
    int nH = H / WH;
    int nW = W / WW;
    int num_windows = nH * nW;
    dim3 grid(num_windows, B);
    dim3 block(32);
    swin_block_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
        x, out,
        ln1_w, ln1_b, qkv_w, qkv_b, proj_w, proj_b,
        ln2_w, ln2_b, fc1_w, fc1_b, fc2_w, fc2_b,
        rpe_bias, H, W);
}

#include "kernel.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <mma.h>
#include <math.h>

using namespace nvcuda;

#define WH 4
#define WW 4
#define N 16
#define C_DIM 32
#define HIDDEN 128
#define WINS_PER_CTA 2

// Multi-window CTA: each CTA processes WINS_PER_CTA windows (one warp per window).
// Use 2 windows per CTA to fit shared memory budget.

__global__ __launch_bounds__(32 * WINS_PER_CTA, 4) void swin_block_kernel(
    const __half* __restrict__ x_in,
    __half* __restrict__ x_out,
    const __half* __restrict__ ln1_w, const __half* __restrict__ ln1_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ qkv_w, const __half* __restrict__ qkv_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ proj_w, const __half* __restrict__ proj_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ ln2_w, const __half* __restrict__ ln2_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ fc1_w, const __half* __restrict__ fc1_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ fc2_w, const __half* __restrict__ fc2_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ rpe_bias,
    int H, int W)
{
    const int warp_id = threadIdx.y;
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int nW = W / WW;
    const int global_win_id = blockIdx.x * WINS_PER_CTA + warp_id;
    const int total_wins = (H / WH) * nW;
    if (global_win_id >= total_wins) return;
    const int b = blockIdx.y;
    const int nh = global_win_id / nW;
    const int nw = global_win_id % nW;

    // Per-warp shared memory tiles
    __shared__ __half x_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half qkv_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][3 * C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half kT_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][C_DIM][N];
    __shared__ __half attn_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][N];
    __shared__ __half out32_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half mlp_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][HIDDEN];
    __shared__ float  resid_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float  attn_f_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][N];
    __shared__ float  tmp_c_s[WINS_PER_CTA][16][16];

    auto x_h = x_h_s[warp_id];
    auto qkv_h = qkv_h_s[warp_id];
    auto kT_h = kT_h_s[warp_id];
    auto attn_h = attn_h_s[warp_id];
    auto out32_h = out32_h_s[warp_id];
    auto mlp_h = mlp_h_s[warp_id];
    auto resid = resid_s[warp_id];
    auto attn_f = attn_f_s[warp_id];
    auto tmp_c = tmp_c_s[warp_id];

    int hh_base = nh * WH;
    int ww_base = nw * WW;

    // ---------- Load input window ----------
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < WH; i++) {
        int hh = hh_base + i;
        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(
            x_in + ((b * H + hh) * W + ww_base) * C_DIM);
        int idx0 = tid;
        int idx1 = tid + 32;
        __half2 v0 = src[idx0];
        __half2 v1 = src[idx1];
        int t0 = idx0 / 16, c0 = (idx0 % 16) * 2;
        int t1 = idx1 / 16, c1 = (idx1 % 16) * 2;
        int n0 = i * WW + t0;
        int n1 = i * WW + t1;
        float2 f0 = __half22float2(v0);
        float2 f1 = __half22float2(v1);
        resid[n0][c0]   = f0.x; resid[n0][c0+1] = f0.y;
        resid[n1][c1]   = f1.x; resid[n1][c1+1] = f1.y;
        x_h[n0][c0]   = v0.x; x_h[n0][c0+1] = v0.y;
        x_h[n1][c1]   = v1.x; x_h[n1][c1+1] = v1.y;
    }

    // ---------- LN1 ----------
    {
        float w = __half2float(ln1_w[tid]);
        float b_ = __half2float(ln1_b[tid]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float v = __half2float(x_h[n][tid]);
            float s = v;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, s, off);
            float mean = s * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float d = v - mean;
            float sq = d * d;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sq += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, sq, off);
            float var = sq * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float inv = rsqrtf(var + 1e-5f);
            x_h[n][tid] = __float2half(d * inv * w + b_);
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ---------- QKV ----------
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;

        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 6; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &x_h[0][kt * 16], C_DIM);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, qkv_w + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(qkv_b[gcol]);
                qkv_h[r][gcol] = __float2half(v);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // Build K^T
    #pragma unroll
    for (int idx = tid; idx < C_DIM * N; idx += 32) {
        int k = idx / N;
        int n = idx % N;
        kT_h[k][n] = qkv_h[n][C_DIM + k];
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ---------- Attn scores ----------
    const float scale = 1.0f / sqrtf((float)C_DIM);
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> b_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
        wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &qkv_h[0][kt * 16], 3 * C_DIM);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, &kT_h[kt * 16][0], N);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
        }
        wmma::store_matrix_sync(&attn_f[0][0], c_frag, N, wmma::mem_row_major);
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // softmax + rpe
    if (tid < N) {
        int i = tid;
        float mx = -1e30f;
        float vals[N];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            float v = attn_f[i][j] * scale + __half2float(rpe_bias[i * N + j]);
            vals[j] = v;
            mx = fmaxf(mx, v);
        }
        float sum = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            float e = __expf(vals[j] - mx);
            vals[j] = e;
            sum += e;
        }
        float inv = 1.0f / sum;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) attn_h[i][j] = __float2half(vals[j] * inv);
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ---------- attn @ V ----------
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> b_frag;
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &attn_h[0][0], N);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, &qkv_h[0][2 * C_DIM + nt * 16], 3 * C_DIM);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                x_h[r][nt * 16 + c] = __float2half(tmp_c[r][c]);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ---------- proj ----------
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &x_h[0][kt * 16], C_DIM);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, proj_w + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(proj_b[gcol]);
                float y = resid[r][gcol] + v;
                resid[r][gcol] = y;
                out32_h[r][gcol] = __float2half(y);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ---------- LN2 ----------
    {
        float w = __half2float(ln2_w[tid]);
        float b_ = __half2float(ln2_b[tid]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float v = __half2float(out32_h[n][tid]);
            float s = v;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, s, off);
            float mean = s * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float d = v - mean;
            float sq = d * d;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sq += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, sq, off);
            float var = sq * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float inv = rsqrtf(var + 1e-5f);
            out32_h[n][tid] = __float2half(d * inv * w + b_);
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ---------- FC1 + GELU ----------
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 8; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &out32_h[0][kt * 16], C_DIM);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, fc1_w + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float a = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(fc1_b[gcol]);
                const float k0 = 0.7978845608f;
                const float k1 = 0.044715f;
                float t = k0 * (a + k1 * a * a * a);
                float g = 0.5f * a * (1.0f + tanhf(t));
                mlp_h[r][gcol] = __float2half(g);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ---------- FC2 ----------
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 8; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &mlp_h[0][kt * 16], HIDDEN);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, fc2_w + (nt * 16) * HIDDEN + kt * 16, HIDDEN);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(fc2_b[gcol]);
                resid[r][gcol] = resid[r][gcol] + v;
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ---------- Store back ----------
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < WH; i++) {
        int hh = hh_base + i;
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(
            x_out + ((b * H + hh) * W + ww_base) * C_DIM);
        int idx0 = tid;
        int idx1 = tid + 32;
        int t0 = idx0 / 16, c0 = (idx0 % 16) * 2;
        int t1 = idx1 / 16, c1 = (idx1 % 16) * 2;
        int n0 = i * WW + t0;
        int n1 = i * WW + t1;
        __half2 h0 = __floats2half2_rn(resid[n0][c0], resid[n0][c0+1]);
        __half2 h1 = __floats2half2_rn(resid[n1][c1], resid[n1][c1+1]);
        dst[idx0] = h0;
        dst[idx1] = h1;
    }
}

void launch_swin_block(
    const __half* x,
    __half* out,
    const __half* ln1_w, const __half* ln1_b,
    const __half* qkv_w, const __half* qkv_b,
    const __half* proj_w, const __half* proj_b,
    const __half* ln2_w, const __half* ln2_b,
    const __half* fc1_w, const __half* fc1_b,
    const __half* fc2_w, const __half* fc2_b,
    const __half* rpe_bias,
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    cudaStream_t stream)
{
    int nH = H / WH;
    int nW = W / WW;
    int num_windows = nH * nW;
    int num_ctas = (num_windows + WINS_PER_CTA - 1) / WINS_PER_CTA;
    dim3 grid(num_ctas, B);
    dim3 block(32, WINS_PER_CTA);
    swin_block_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
        x, out,
        ln1_w, ln1_b, qkv_w, qkv_b, proj_w, proj_b,
        ln2_w, ln2_b, fc1_w, fc1_b, fc2_w, fc2_b,
        rpe_bias, H, W);
}

#include "kernel.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <mma.h>
#include <math.h>

using namespace nvcuda;

#define WH 4
#define WW 4
#define N 16
#define C_DIM 32
#define HIDDEN 128
#define WINS_PER_CTA 2

// Multi-window CTA: each CTA processes WINS_PER_CTA windows (one warp per window).
// Use 2 windows per CTA to fit shared memory budget.

__global__ __launch_bounds__(32 * WINS_PER_CTA, 4) void swin_block_kernel(
    const __half* __restrict__ x_in,
    __half* __restrict__ x_out,
    const __half* __restrict__ ln1_w, const __half* __restrict__ ln1_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ qkv_w, const __half* __restrict__ qkv_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ proj_w, const __half* __restrict__ proj_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ ln2_w, const __half* __restrict__ ln2_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ fc1_w, const __half* __restrict__ fc1_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ fc2_w, const __half* __restrict__ fc2_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ rpe_bias,
    int H, int W)
{
    const int warp_id = threadIdx.y;
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int nW = W / WW;
    const int global_win_id = blockIdx.x * WINS_PER_CTA + warp_id;
    const int total_wins = (H / WH) * nW;
    if (global_win_id >= total_wins) return;
    const int b = blockIdx.y;
    const int nh = global_win_id / nW;
    const int nw = global_win_id % nW;

    // Per-warp shared memory tiles
    __shared__ __half x_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half qkv_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][3 * C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half kT_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][C_DIM][N];
    __shared__ __half attn_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][N];
    __shared__ __half out32_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half mlp_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][HIDDEN];
    __shared__ float  resid_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float  attn_f_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][N];
    __shared__ float  tmp_c_s[WINS_PER_CTA][16][16];

    auto x_h = x_h_s[warp_id];
    auto qkv_h = qkv_h_s[warp_id];
    auto kT_h = kT_h_s[warp_id];
    auto attn_h = attn_h_s[warp_id];
    auto out32_h = out32_h_s[warp_id];
    auto mlp_h = mlp_h_s[warp_id];
    auto resid = resid_s[warp_id];
    auto attn_f = attn_f_s[warp_id];
    auto tmp_c = tmp_c_s[warp_id];

    int hh_base = nh * WH;
    int ww_base = nw * WW;

    // ---------- Load input window ----------
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < WH; i++) {
        int hh = hh_base + i;
        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(
            x_in + ((b * H + hh) * W + ww_base) * C_DIM);
        int idx0 = tid;
        int idx1 = tid + 32;
        __half2 v0 = src[idx0];
        __half2 v1 = src[idx1];
        int t0 = idx0 / 16, c0 = (idx0 % 16) * 2;
        int t1 = idx1 / 16, c1 = (idx1 % 16) * 2;
        int n0 = i * WW + t0;
        int n1 = i * WW + t1;
        float2 f0 = __half22float2(v0);
        float2 f1 = __half22float2(v1);
        resid[n0][c0]   = f0.x; resid[n0][c0+1] = f0.y;
        resid[n1][c1]   = f1.x; resid[n1][c1+1] = f1.y;
        x_h[n0][c0]   = v0.x; x_h[n0][c0+1] = v0.y;
        x_h[n1][c1]   = v1.x; x_h[n1][c1+1] = v1.y;
    }

    // ---------- LN1 ----------
    {
        float w = __half2float(ln1_w[tid]);
        float b_ = __half2float(ln1_b[tid]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float v = __half2float(x_h[n][tid]);
            float s = v;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, s, off);
            float mean = s * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float d = v - mean;
            float sq = d * d;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sq += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, sq, off);
            float var = sq * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float inv = rsqrtf(var + 1e-5f);
            x_h[n][tid] = __float2half(d * inv * w + b_);
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ---------- QKV ----------
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;

        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 6; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &x_h[0][kt * 16], C_DIM);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, qkv_w + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(qkv_b[gcol]);
                qkv_h[r][gcol] = __float2half(v);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // Build K^T
    #pragma unroll
    for (int idx = tid; idx < C_DIM * N; idx += 32) {
        int k = idx / N;
        int n = idx % N;
        kT_h[k][n] = qkv_h[n][C_DIM + k];
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ---------- Attn scores ----------
    const float scale = 1.0f / sqrtf((float)C_DIM);
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> b_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
        wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &qkv_h[0][kt * 16], 3 * C_DIM);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, &kT_h[kt * 16][0], N);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
        }
        wmma::store_matrix_sync(&attn_f[0][0], c_frag, N, wmma::mem_row_major);
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // softmax + rpe
    if (tid < N) {
        int i = tid;
        float mx = -1e30f;
        float vals[N];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            float v = attn_f[i][j] * scale + __half2float(rpe_bias[i * N + j]);
            vals[j] = v;
            mx = fmaxf(mx, v);
        }
        float sum = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            float e = __expf(vals[j] - mx);
            vals[j] = e;
            sum += e;
        }
        float inv = 1.0f / sum;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) attn_h[i][j] = __float2half(vals[j] * inv);
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ---------- attn @ V ----------
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> b_frag;
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &attn_h[0][0], N);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, &qkv_h[0][2 * C_DIM + nt * 16], 3 * C_DIM);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                x_h[r][nt * 16 + c] = __float2half(tmp_c[r][c]);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ---------- proj ----------
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &x_h[0][kt * 16], C_DIM);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, proj_w + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(proj_b[gcol]);
                float y = resid[r][gcol] + v;
                resid[r][gcol] = y;
                out32_h[r][gcol] = __float2half(y);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ---------- LN2 ----------
    {
        float w = __half2float(ln2_w[tid]);
        float b_ = __half2float(ln2_b[tid]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float v = __half2float(out32_h[n][tid]);
            float s = v;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, s, off);
            float mean = s * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float d = v - mean;
            float sq = d * d;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sq += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, sq, off);
            float var = sq * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float inv = rsqrtf(var + 1e-5f);
            out32_h[n][tid] = __float2half(d * inv * w + b_);
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    // ---------- FC1 + GELU ----------
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 8; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &out32_h[0][kt * 16], C_DIM);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, fc1_w + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float a = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(fc1_b[gcol]);
                const float k0 = 0.7978845608f;
                const float k1 = 0.044715f;
                float t = k0 * (a + k1 * a * a * a);
                float g = 0.5f * a * (1.0f + tanhf(t));
                mlp_h[r][gcol] = __float2half(g);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ---------- FC2 ----------
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 8; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &mlp_h[0][kt * 16], HIDDEN);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, fc2_w + (nt * 16) * HIDDEN + kt * 16, HIDDEN);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(fc2_b[gcol]);
                resid[r][gcol] = resid[r][gcol] + v;
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    // ---------- Store back ----------
    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < WH; i++) {
        int hh = hh_base + i;
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(
            x_out + ((b * H + hh) * W + ww_base) * C_DIM);
        int idx0 = tid;
        int idx1 = tid + 32;
        int t0 = idx0 / 16, c0 = (idx0 % 16) * 2;
        int t1 = idx1 / 16, c1 = (idx1 % 16) * 2;
        int n0 = i * WW + t0;
        int n1 = i * WW + t1;
        __half2 h0 = __floats2half2_rn(resid[n0][c0], resid[n0][c0+1]);
        __half2 h1 = __floats2half2_rn(resid[n1][c1], resid[n1][c1+1]);
        dst[idx0] = h0;
        dst[idx1] = h1;
    }
}

void launch_swin_block(
    const __half* x,
    __half* out,
    const __half* ln1_w, const __half* ln1_b,
    const __half* qkv_w, const __half* qkv_b,
    const __half* proj_w, const __half* proj_b,
    const __half* ln2_w, const __half* ln2_b,
    const __half* fc1_w, const __half* fc1_b,
    const __half* fc2_w, const __half* fc2_b,
    const __half* rpe_bias,
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    cudaStream_t stream)
{
    int nH = H / WH;
    int nW = W / WW;
    int num_windows = nH * nW;
    int num_ctas = (num_windows + WINS_PER_CTA - 1) / WINS_PER_CTA;
    dim3 grid(num_ctas, B);
    dim3 block(32, WINS_PER_CTA);
    swin_block_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
        x, out,
        ln1_w, ln1_b, qkv_w, qkv_b, proj_w, proj_b,
        ln2_w, ln2_b, fc1_w, fc1_b, fc2_w, fc2_b,
        rpe_bias, H, W);
}

#include "kernel.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <mma.h>
#include <math.h>

using namespace nvcuda;

#define WH 4
#define WW 4
#define N 16
#define C_DIM 32
#define HIDDEN 128
#define WINS_PER_CTA 2

// Reverted from WINS_PER_CTA=4 (which overflowed 48KB static smem budget,
// ptxas reported 0x10800 > 0xc000) back to 2 windows per CTA — matches the
// known-good base config.

__global__ __launch_bounds__(32 * WINS_PER_CTA, 4) void swin_block_kernel(
    const __half* __restrict__ x_in,
    __half* __restrict__ x_out,
    const __half* __restrict__ ln1_w, const __half* __restrict__ ln1_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ qkv_w_g, const __half* __restrict__ qkv_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ proj_w_g, const __half* __restrict__ proj_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ ln2_w, const __half* __restrict__ ln2_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ fc1_w_g, const __half* __restrict__ fc1_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ fc2_w_g, const __half* __restrict__ fc2_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ rpe_bias,
    int H, int W)
{
    const int warp_id = threadIdx.y;
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int nW = W / WW;

    __shared__ __half qkv_w_s[3 * C_DIM * C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half proj_w_s[C_DIM * C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half fc1_w_s[HIDDEN * C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half fc2_w_s[C_DIM * HIDDEN];

    __shared__ __half x_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half attn_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][N];
    __shared__ __half out32_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float  resid_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float  attn_f_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][N];
    __shared__ float  tmp_c_s[WINS_PER_CTA][16][16];

    __shared__ __half mlp_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N * HIDDEN];

    __half* qkv_h_raw = &mlp_h_s[warp_id][0];
    __half* kT_h_raw  = &mlp_h_s[warp_id][N * 3 * C_DIM];

    auto qkv_h = reinterpret_cast<__half (*)[3 * C_DIM]>(qkv_h_raw);
    auto kT_h  = reinterpret_cast<__half (*)[N]>(kT_h_raw);
    __half* mlp_h_flat = &mlp_h_s[warp_id][0];

    const int total_threads = blockDim.x * blockDim.y;
    const int lin_tid = warp_id * blockDim.x + tid;

    {
        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(qkv_w_g);
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(qkv_w_s);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = lin_tid; i < 1536; i += total_threads) dst[i] = src[i];
    }
    {
        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(proj_w_g);
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(proj_w_s);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = lin_tid; i < 512; i += total_threads) dst[i] = src[i];
    }
    {
        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(fc1_w_g);
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(fc1_w_s);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = lin_tid; i < 2048; i += total_threads) dst[i] = src[i];
    }
    {
        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(fc2_w_g);
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(fc2_w_s);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = lin_tid; i < 2048; i += total_threads) dst[i] = src[i];
    }
    __syncthreads();

    const int global_win_id = blockIdx.x * WINS_PER_CTA + warp_id;
    const int total_wins = (H / WH) * nW;
    if (global_win_id >= total_wins) return;
    const int b = blockIdx.y;
    const int nh = global_win_id / nW;
    const int nw = global_win_id % nW;

    auto x_h = x_h_s[warp_id];
    auto attn_h = attn_h_s[warp_id];
    auto out32_h = out32_h_s[warp_id];
    auto resid = resid_s[warp_id];
    auto attn_f = attn_f_s[warp_id];
    auto tmp_c = tmp_c_s[warp_id];

    int ww_base = nw * WW;

        int idx1 = tid + 32;
        __half2 v0 = src[idx0];
        __half2 v1 = src[idx1];
        int t0 = idx0 / 16, c0 = (idx0 % 16) * 2;
        int t1 = idx1 / 16, c1 = (idx1 % 16) * 2;
        int n0 = i * WW + t0;
        int n1 = i * WW + t1;
        float2 f0 = __half22float2(v0);
        float2 f1 = __half22float2(v1);
        resid[n0][c0]   = f0.x; resid[n0][c0+1] = f0.y;
        resid[n1][c1]   = f1.x; resid[n1][c1+1] = f1.y;
        x_h[n0][c0]   = v0.x; x_h[n0][c0+1] = v0.y;
        x_h[n1][c1]   = v1.x; x_h[n1][c1+1] = v1.y;
    }

        float w = __half2float(ln1_w[tid]);
        float b_ = __half2float(ln1_b[tid]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float v = __half2float(x_h[n][tid]);
            float s = v;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, s, off);
            float mean = s * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float d = v - mean;
            float sq = d * d;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sq += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, sq, off);
            float var = sq * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);

            x_h[n][tid] = __float2half(d * inv * w + b_);

        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;

        for (int nt = 0; nt < 6; nt++) {

            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);

            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {

                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, qkv_w_s + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);

            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(qkv_b[gcol]);

    for (int idx = tid; idx < C_DIM * N; idx += 32) {

        int n = idx % N;

    }

        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> b_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
        wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &qkv_h[0][kt * 16], 3 * C_DIM);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, &kT_h[kt * 16][0], N);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
        }
        wmma::store_matrix_sync(&attn_f[0][0], c_frag, N, wmma::mem_row_major);
    }
    __syncwarp();

    if (tid < N) {
        int i = tid;
        float mx = -1e30f;
        float vals[N];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            float v = attn_f[i][j] * scale + __half2float(rpe_bias[i * N + j]);
            vals[j] = v;
            mx = fmaxf(mx, v);
        }
        float sum = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            float e = __expf(vals[j] - mx);

        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> b_frag;
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &attn_h[0][0], N);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, &qkv_h[0][2 * C_DIM + nt * 16], 3 * C_DIM);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                x_h[r][nt * 16 + c] = __float2half(tmp_c[r][c]);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &x_h[0][kt * 16], C_DIM);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, proj_w_s + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(proj_b[gcol]);
                float y = resid[r][gcol] + v;
                resid[r][gcol] = y;
                out32_h[r][gcol] = __float2half(y);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }

        float w = __half2float(ln2_w[tid]);
        float b_ = __half2float(ln2_b[tid]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float v = __half2float(out32_h[n][tid]);
            float s = v;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, s, off);
            float mean = s * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float d = v - mean;
            float sq = d * d;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sq += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, sq, off);
            float var = sq * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float inv = rsqrtf(var + 1e-5f);
            out32_h[n][tid] = __float2half(d * inv * w + b_);

    __syncwarp();

    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 8; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &out32_h[0][kt * 16], C_DIM);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, fc1_w_s + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float a = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(fc1_b[gcol]);
                const float k0 = 0.7978845608f;
                const float k1 = 0.044715f;
                float t = k0 * (a + k1 * a * a * a);
                float g = 0.5f * a * (1.0f + tanhf(t));
                mlp_h_flat[r * HIDDEN + gcol] = __float2half(g);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }

        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 8; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, mlp_h_flat + kt * 16, HIDDEN);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, fc2_w_s + (nt * 16) * HIDDEN + kt * 16, HIDDEN);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(fc2_b[gcol]);
                resid[r][gcol] = resid[r][gcol] + v;
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < WH; i++) {
        int hh = hh_base + i;
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(
            x_out + ((b * H + hh) * W + ww_base) * C_DIM);

        __half2 h1 = __floats2half2_rn(resid[n1][c1], resid[n1][c1+1]);
        dst[idx0] = h0;
        dst[idx1] = h1;
    }
}

void launch_swin_block(
    const __half* x,
    __half* out,
    const __half* ln1_w, const __half* ln1_b,
    const __half* qkv_w, const __half* qkv_b,
    const __half* proj_w, const __half* proj_b,

    const __half* fc2_w, const __half* fc2_b,
    const __half* rpe_bias,
    int B, int H, int W, int C,
    cudaStream_t stream)
{
    int nH = H / WH;
    int nW = W / WW;
    int num_windows = nH * nW;
    int num_ctas = (num_windows + WINS_PER_CTA - 1) / WINS_PER_CTA;
    dim3 grid(num_ctas, B);
    dim3 block(32, WINS_PER_CTA);
    swin_block_kernel<<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
        x, out,
        ln1_w, ln1_b, qkv_w, qkv_b, proj_w, proj_b,
        ln2_w, ln2_b, fc1_w, fc1_b, fc2_w, fc2_b,
        rpe_bias, H, W);
}

#include "kernel.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <mma.h>
#include <math.h>

using namespace nvcuda;

#define WH 4
#define WW 4
#define N 16
#define C_DIM 32
#define HIDDEN 128
#define WINS_PER_CTA 2

// Reverted from WINS_PER_CTA=4 (which overflowed 48KB static smem budget,
// ptxas reported 0x10800 > 0xc000) back to 2 windows per CTA — matches the
// known-good base config.

__global__ __launch_bounds__(32 * WINS_PER_CTA, 4) void swin_block_kernel(
    const __half* __restrict__ x_in,
    __half* __restrict__ x_out,
    const __half* __restrict__ ln1_w, const __half* __restrict__ ln1_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ qkv_w_g, const __half* __restrict__ qkv_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ proj_w_g, const __half* __restrict__ proj_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ ln2_w, const __half* __restrict__ ln2_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ fc1_w_g, const __half* __restrict__ fc1_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ fc2_w_g, const __half* __restrict__ fc2_b,
    const __half* __restrict__ rpe_bias,
    int H, int W)
{
    const int warp_id = threadIdx.y;
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int nW = W / WW;

    __shared__ __half qkv_w_s[3 * C_DIM * C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half proj_w_s[C_DIM * C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half fc1_w_s[HIDDEN * C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half fc2_w_s[C_DIM * HIDDEN];

    __shared__ __half x_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ __half attn_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][N];
    __shared__ __half out32_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float  resid_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][C_DIM];
    __shared__ float  attn_f_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N][N];
    __shared__ float  tmp_c_s[WINS_PER_CTA][16][16];

    __shared__ __half mlp_h_s[WINS_PER_CTA][N * HIDDEN];

    __half* qkv_h_raw = &mlp_h_s[warp_id][0];
    __half* kT_h_raw  = &mlp_h_s[warp_id][N * 3 * C_DIM];

    auto qkv_h = reinterpret_cast<__half (*)[3 * C_DIM]>(qkv_h_raw);
    auto kT_h  = reinterpret_cast<__half (*)[N]>(kT_h_raw);
    __half* mlp_h_flat = &mlp_h_s[warp_id][0];

    const int total_threads = blockDim.x * blockDim.y;
    const int lin_tid = warp_id * blockDim.x + tid;

    {
        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(qkv_w_g);
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(qkv_w_s);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = lin_tid; i < 1536; i += total_threads) dst[i] = src[i];
    }
    {
        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(proj_w_g);
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(proj_w_s);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = lin_tid; i < 512; i += total_threads) dst[i] = src[i];
    }
    {
        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(fc1_w_g);
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(fc1_w_s);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = lin_tid; i < 2048; i += total_threads) dst[i] = src[i];
    }
    {
        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(fc2_w_g);
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(fc2_w_s);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int i = lin_tid; i < 2048; i += total_threads) dst[i] = src[i];
    }
    __syncthreads();

    const int global_win_id = blockIdx.x * WINS_PER_CTA + warp_id;
    const int total_wins = (H / WH) * nW;
    if (global_win_id >= total_wins) return;
    const int b = blockIdx.y;
    const int nh = global_win_id / nW;
    const int nw = global_win_id % nW;

    auto x_h = x_h_s[warp_id];
    auto attn_h = attn_h_s[warp_id];
    auto out32_h = out32_h_s[warp_id];
    auto resid = resid_s[warp_id];
    auto attn_f = attn_f_s[warp_id];
    auto tmp_c = tmp_c_s[warp_id];

    int hh_base = nh * WH;
    int ww_base = nw * WW;

    for (int i = 0; i < WH; i++) {

        const __half2* src = reinterpret_cast<const __half2*>(
            x_in + ((b * H + hh) * W + ww_base) * C_DIM);
        int idx0 = tid;
        int idx1 = tid + 32;
        __half2 v0 = src[idx0];
        __half2 v1 = src[idx1];
        int t0 = idx0 / 16, c0 = (idx0 % 16) * 2;
        int t1 = idx1 / 16, c1 = (idx1 % 16) * 2;
        int n0 = i * WW + t0;
        int n1 = i * WW + t1;
        float2 f0 = __half22float2(v0);
        float2 f1 = __half22float2(v1);
        resid[n0][c0]   = f0.x; resid[n0][c0+1] = f0.y;
        resid[n1][c1]   = f1.x; resid[n1][c1+1] = f1.y;
        x_h[n0][c0]   = v0.x; x_h[n0][c0+1] = v0.y;
        x_h[n1][c1]   = v1.x; x_h[n1][c1+1] = v1.y;
    }

    {
        float w = __half2float(ln1_w[tid]);
        float b_ = __half2float(ln1_b[tid]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float v = __half2float(x_h[n][tid]);
            float s = v;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, s, off);
            float mean = s * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float d = v - mean;
            float sq = d * d;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sq += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, sq, off);
            float var = sq * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);

            x_h[n][tid] = __float2half(d * inv * w + b_);

        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;

        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 6; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &x_h[0][kt * 16], C_DIM);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, qkv_w_s + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(qkv_b[gcol]);
                qkv_h[r][gcol] = __float2half(v);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    #pragma unroll
    for (int idx = tid; idx < C_DIM * N; idx += 32) {
        int k = idx / N;
        int n = idx % N;
        kT_h[k][n] = qkv_h[n][C_DIM + k];
    }
    __syncwarp();

    const float scale = 1.0f / sqrtf((float)C_DIM);
    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> b_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
        wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &qkv_h[0][kt * 16], 3 * C_DIM);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, &kT_h[kt * 16][0], N);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
        }
        wmma::store_matrix_sync(&attn_f[0][0], c_frag, N, wmma::mem_row_major);
    }
    __syncwarp();

    if (tid < N) {
        int i = tid;
        float mx = -1e30f;
        float vals[N];
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            float v = attn_f[i][j] * scale + __half2float(rpe_bias[i * N + j]);
            vals[j] = v;
            mx = fmaxf(mx, v);
        }
        float sum = 0.f;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            float e = __expf(vals[j] - mx);
            vals[j] = e;
            sum += e;
        }
        float inv = 1.0f / sum;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) attn_h[i][j] = __float2half(vals[j] * inv);
    }
    __syncwarp();

    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> b_frag;
        wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &attn_h[0][0], N);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, &qkv_h[0][2 * C_DIM + nt * 16], 3 * C_DIM);
            wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                x_h[r][nt * 16 + c] = __float2half(tmp_c[r][c]);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &x_h[0][kt * 16], C_DIM);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, proj_w_s + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(proj_b[gcol]);
                float y = resid[r][gcol] + v;
                resid[r][gcol] = y;
                out32_h[r][gcol] = __float2half(y);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    {
        float w = __half2float(ln2_w[tid]);
        float b_ = __half2float(ln2_b[tid]);
        #pragma unroll
        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
            float v = __half2float(out32_h[n][tid]);
            float s = v;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) s += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, s, off);
            float mean = s * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float d = v - mean;
            float sq = d * d;
            for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sq += __shfl_xor_sync(0xffffffff, sq, off);
            float var = sq * (1.0f / (float)C_DIM);
            float inv = rsqrtf(var + 1e-5f);
            out32_h[n][tid] = __float2half(d * inv * w + b_);
        }
    }
    __syncwarp();

    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 8; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 2; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, &out32_h[0][kt * 16], C_DIM);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, fc1_w_s + (nt * 16) * C_DIM + kt * 16, C_DIM);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float a = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(fc1_b[gcol]);
                const float k0 = 0.7978845608f;
                const float k1 = 0.044715f;
                float t = k0 * (a + k1 * a * a * a);
                float g = 0.5f * a * (1.0f + tanhf(t));
                mlp_h_flat[r * HIDDEN + gcol] = __float2half(g);
            }
            __syncwarp();
        }
    }

    {
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_a, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::row_major> a_frag;
        wmma::fragment<wmma::matrix_b, 16, 16, 16, __half, wmma::col_major> b_frag;
        #pragma unroll
        for (int nt = 0; nt < 2; nt++) {
            wmma::fragment<wmma::accumulator, 16, 16, 16, float> c_frag;
            wmma::fill_fragment(c_frag, 0.0f);
            #pragma unroll
            for (int kt = 0; kt < 8; kt++) {
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(a_frag, mlp_h_flat + kt * 16, HIDDEN);
                wmma::load_matrix_sync(b_frag, fc2_w_s + (nt * 16) * HIDDEN + kt * 16, HIDDEN);
                wmma::mma_sync(c_frag, a_frag, b_frag, c_frag);
            }
            wmma::store_matrix_sync(&tmp_c[0][0], c_frag, 16, wmma::mem_row_major);
            __syncwarp();
            #pragma unroll
            for (int idx = tid; idx < 16 * 16; idx += 32) {
                int r = idx / 16, c = idx % 16;
                int gcol = nt * 16 + c;
                float v = tmp_c[r][c] + __half2float(fc2_b[gcol]);

            __syncwarp();
        }

    #pragma unroll
    for (int i = 0; i < WH; i++) {
        int hh = hh_base + i;
        __half2* dst = reinterpret_cast<__half2*>(
            x_out + ((b * H + hh) * W + ww_base) * C_DIM);
        int idx0 = tid;
        int idx1 = tid + 32;
        int t0 = idx0 / 16, c0 = (idx0 % 16) * 2;
        int t1 = idx1 / 16, c1 = (idx1 % 16) * 2;
        int n0 = i * WW + t0;
        int n1 = i * WW + t1;

        __half2 h1 = __floats2half2_rn(resid[n1][c1], resid[n1][c1+1]);
        dst[idx0] = h0;
        dst[idx1] = h1;
    }
}

    const __half* x,
    __half* out,
    const __half* ln1_w, const __half* ln1_b,

    const __half* proj_w, const __half* proj_b,
    const __half* ln2_w, const __half* ln2_b,
